name: Cyient DLM Ltd
title: Cyient DLM Ltd - 543933 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: FY26 revenue fell 17% to INR12,615m while order book hit a record INR24,166m (book-to-bill 1.5x); management gave no FY27 revenue number, only directional growth.

triggers.label: Order book INR24,166m, highest in 10 quarters
triggers.quote: The order book reached its highest level in last 10 quarters.

triggers.label: Inventory days elevated, DSO mid-70s
triggers.quote: Inventory days remained elevated through FY '26, largely driven by advanced stocking for the long-lead components and program ramp -ups.
triggers.highlight: Inventory days remained elevated through FY '26

triggers.label: No FY27 revenue guidance given
triggers.quote: we are not giving any other guidance right now on the revenue side
triggers.highlight: not giving any other guidance right now on the revenue side

triggers.label: Q4 margin 11.7% EBITDA, sequential high
triggers.quote: EBITDA improved 11.7% and PAT stood at 6.1%.

guidance.value: Growth expected YoY in all four quarters; no numeric guidance
guidance.quote: FY '27, you'll be starting seeing the growth, year-over-year growth we'll be seeing it in all the quarters
we are confident of sustaining the margins moving forward
Our target is to reach about 100 to 120 in terms of the number of days

prior_guidance_check.metric: Q4 revenue / YoY growth (from Q3 call)
prior_guidance_check.quote: we were confident of meeting our revenue Y -o-Y as well
we are not giving any guidance right now on that

red_flags.label: Q4 revenue down 13.8% YoY, FY26 down 17%
red_flags.quote: On a year -on-year basis, it is down by 13.8%, mainly due to the large order closure in Q4 FY '25.

red_flags.label: Revenue shortfall attributed to West Asia material delays
red_flags.quote: the materials got delayed, that's usually all our m aterials comes through the European -- I mean West Asia

red_flags.label: Other expenses rising despite revenue decline
red_flags.quote: our other expenses have gone from INR29 crores to INR44 crores.

red_flags.label: Order book definition is POs only, excludes TCV
red_flags.quote: We won't take anything which is a TCV and all those, we won't take it as a part of our order book.

evasions.quote: We are not giving any guidance right now on that in terms of how much of the order intake will be converted as a revenue in FY '27
We don't want to get into the exact quantification of this stuff.
the other expenses is a mix of both the India and U.S. operations put together
